messages:
maris: quick follow-up from the postmortem: three issues left to track - missing spans, aggregation drift, and ETL lag. putting owners + dates here.
raj: thanks. please include ticket IDs so we can track in the weekly runbook.
anya: created tickets: RDW-8101 (span-loss hotfix) -> @anya; RDW-8102 (aggregation regression tests + dashboard) -> @sam; RDW-8103 (etl backpressure fix) -> @maris.
maris: proposed due dates: RDW-8101 -> 48h, RDW-8102 -> 10d, RDW-8103 design -> 2w.
raj: @anya will the hotfix include an incrementing metric and a debug sampler? we need better signals.
anya: yes. adding metric observability.trace.missing_spans and a 0.05% full-trace sampler. PR tomorrow AM.
sam: aggregation tests plan: golden dataset + nightly diff job, alert on >1.5% deviation for top-10 customers. RDW-8150 tracks nightly runner.
maris: ops-bot, add temporary alert for span ingest rate drop >25% over 10m -> eng-oncall + observability.
ops-bot: alert created TEMP-OBS-SPAN-25. Escalation: eng-oncall -> observability.
raj: add a dashboard card with span completeness by region so CS/PM can see impact.
anya: hotfix PR -> https://git.redwood/rdw/trace/pulls/1901. will merge to canary and run smoke.
sam: I'll add dashboard card and link to RDW-8102. nightly runner code in a branch, pushing CI tomorrow.
maris: for ETL lag, I found large batch serialization spikes. plan is chunking + async persist. RFC by next Wed.
raj: recurring checks? we've seen span drops multiple times.
anya: creating RDW-8151 for weekly golden-path smoke; platform QA will own.
maris: summary: RDW-8101 (anya) hotfix & metric - due +48h; RDW-8102 (sam) aggregation tests & dashboard - due 10d; RDW-8103 (maris) ETL mitigation RFC - due 2w; RDW-8151 (platform QA) weekly smoke - ongoing.
raj: weekly sync: Mondays 10:00 PT. post 1-line updates here each week.
anya: hotfix merged to canary, smoke logs: ```
OK span-hotfix-smoke 10s
observability.trace.missing_spans = 0
```
maris: thanks. will monitor metrics and report if alert fires.
sam: pushing nightly runner CI job tonight.
raj: good work. keep ticket comments up to date and ping if blocked.
anya: thanks everyone.
maris: thanks.
sam: thanks!
